# Grewal Shopfront & Shutters

> Professional aluminium shopfront installation, roller shutters, security doors, and emergency repairs across the UK. Based in Exhall, Coventry, West Midlands.

## About

Grewal Shopfront Shutter Windows And Doors Limited is a Companies House registered shopfront installation company serving commercial premises across the UK. We specialise in aluminium shopfronts, roller shutters, security doors, automatic doors, bi-fold doors, fire doors, curtain walling, glass shopfronts, and 24/7 emergency callout services. Our team provides free site surveys and no-obligation quotes for all shopfront projects.

## Services

- [Aluminium Shopfronts](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/aluminium-shopfronts): Thermally broken aluminium systems with toughened glazing, powder-coated in any RAL colour.
- [Roller Shutters](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/roller-shutters): Steel and aluminium security shutters — manual, electric, or remote-controlled operation.
- [Security Doors](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/security-doors): LPS 1175 rated steel and composite doors for maximum premises security.
- [Automatic Doors](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/automatic-doors): Sliding, swing, and revolving entrance systems compliant with BS 7036.
- [Bi-Fold Doors](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/bi-fold-doors): Commercial-grade aluminium folding door systems.
- [Fire Doors](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/fire-doors): FD30, FD60, and FD90 certified fire-rated doorsets for commercial premises.
- [Shopfront Repairs](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/shopfront-repairs): Same-day glass, frame, and mechanism repair services.
- [Emergency Callout](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/emergency-callout): 24/7 rapid response boarding and emergency glazing across the UK.
- [Shutter Repair](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/shutter-repair): Fast roller shutter repair and maintenance services.
- [Glass Replacement](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/glass-replacement): Commercial shopfront glass replacement and reglazing.
- [Aluminium Doors](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/aluminium-doors): Commercial aluminium entrance door systems.
- [Aluminium Windows](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/aluminium-windows): Thermally efficient aluminium window systems for commercial premises.
- [Curtain Walling](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/curtain-walling): Full-height glazed curtain wall systems for modern commercial buildings.
- [Glass Shopfronts](https://www.grewalshopfrontandshutters.co.uk/services/glass-shopfronts): Frameless and semi-frameless toughened glass shopfront systems.

## Service Areas

We cover London, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, Liverpool, Sheffield, Bristol, Leicester, Nottingham, Coventry, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Cardiff, Newcastle, Southampton, Brighton, Wolverhampton, Derby, Northampton, Luton, Swindon, Stoke-on-Trent, Plymouth, Bradford, Swansea, Oxford, Cambridge, York, Bath, Aberdeen, Belfast, Milton Keynes, Middlesbrough, Bournemouth, Portsmouth, Norwich, Exeter, Chester, Gloucester, Peterborough, and Reading.
